id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying 402 payment required on cohorts endpoint

review.posthog_relevance: Billing and authentication error handling, preventing unnecessary retry loops for terminal payment or permission errors.
review.reason: Adds HTTP 402 and 401/403 to the non-retryable error dictionary, classifying billing and authentication failures as terminal errors while retaining retries for transient errors.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk P1.F1.H1; no broader context or test execution results are available to independently verify the implementation or its actual runtime behavior.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new entry to the non-retryable error dictionary, mapping HTTP 402 status to a billing-related message, and adds tests asserting that 402, 401, and 403 errors are classified as non-retryable while 429 and 500 remain retryable.
observations.posthog_connection: This change classifies Mixpanel billing and authentication failures as terminal errors, preventing unnecessary retry loops for payment or permission issues, while retaining retries for transient overloads or server errors.
